name: AMC Aurora
description: A bright, airy style: an aurora gradient header from deep teal to violet, a soft cool page, crisp white regions with a faint top glow and a teal primary.
helpText: Light style built on Vita. The header and the current menu entry use an aurora gradient from teal to violet; regions are white with a soft cool shadow; the primary color is a deep teal that passes WCAG AA with white text. Works with every AMC component and template, which read the same --ut-* variables. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
